statements.t: We are also progressing on our capacity expansion plans, and we expect to increase our throughput in the second half of 2026.
In Power & Energy , our positive outlook for 2026 continues to reflect strong demand in both Power Generation and Oil & Gas.

We continue to anticipate growth in Power Generation for both reciprocating engines and turbines and turbine-related services , driven by increasing energy demand to support data center build-out related to cloud computing and generative Artificial Intelligence (AI).

In Construction Industries , in 2026 as compared to 2025, we continue to expect growth in sales of equipment to end users supported by strong order rates.

While the Middle East continues to be challenged, we currently anticipate only a limited impact on sales of equipment to end users in EAME.
In China, we anticipate moderate conditions, with growth in the above 10-ton excavator industry in 2026, off of low levels of activity.
We now expect rebuild activity in 2026 to increase moderately as compared to 2025.
